description: This Java class defines a filter for verifying the format of Tenant API request messages in the Eclipse Hono project. It checks whether messages contain required properties like correlation ID, subject, and reply-to address.

classes.name: TenantMessageFilter
classes.description: A final class extending BaseMessageFilter that provides a static method to verify message format for tenant API requests.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Static method that checks whether a message contains required properties: correlation ID, subject, and reply-to address, and logs trace messages if checks fail.
